thread:
alex: Heads up — ap-southeast1 GPU pool is failing a bunch of node bootstraps, looks like KMS decrypt errors and then autoscaler backing off. seeing ~40% of new nodes bounce.
alex: sample from node-agent logs:```2026-03-20T09:12:07Z node-agent pod/gpu-warmup-3 stderr: error: kms.DecryptResource RateLimitExceeded: request throttled
status code: 429, request id: f2a1b3c4
2026-03-20T09:12:12Z node-agent pod/gpu-warmup-5 stderr: error: failed to fetch key: context deadline exceeded
```
deploy-bot: Alert created: INCIDENT-APAC-KMS-THROTTLE, paging eng-platform + eng-infra.
maria: Ugh. This is the region where we use ephemeral KMS keys per node for disk encryption, right?
alex: yep, we switched to per-node ephemeral keys for extra isolation last quarter. good for compliance but KMS quota looks exhausted.
sam: Are we hitting global KMS per-minute limits or a regional keyring limit? Can we get metrics from cloud KMS?
alex: prelim from metrics — DecryptOps spiked to 3.2k/min in ap-southeast1, account-level throttle. other regions fine.
leah: audit/logging queued too — some services blocked waiting on decrypt, causing pod startup jitter and autoscaler thinking capacity is unhealthy. cost risk if we keep scaling.
maria: short term mitigation: can we enable a local decrypt cache in node-agent with a short TTL (e.g., 15m) so multiple bootstraps reuse the same plaintext? config might look like:```node_agent.kms_cache:
  enabled: true
  ttl_seconds: 900
  ttl_jitter: 60
```
alex: that would help on the host side for repeated decrypts during warmup. but we still need to reduce KMS QPS.
sam: we can also route non-sensitive bootstrap decrypts to a regional fallback key with delegated access, cheaper and lower throttling. create a limited-scope IAM role that can use fallback-key for image-level secrets only.
leah: we should check compliance implications — fallback key must be auditable and tagged, and audit retention needs to capture the delegated calls. audit-bot: KMS logs show 92% of requests are from warm pool builder service account.
leah: can we temporarily pause warm pool replenishment to spread decrypt requests over time? maybe reduce warm pool target by 30% for 1 hour.
maria: yes, reduce warm pool and enable caching. also request an emergency KMS quota bump with cloud provider. I'll open the support ticket now.
alex: ticket created: CLOUD-123456 — requested increase to DecryptOps for ap-southeast1. ETA unknown.
sam: while waiting, propose immediate plan: 1) enable node-agent kms_cache ttl=900, 2) scale down warm pool target by 30%, 3) enable delegated fallback key for non-PII bootstraps, 4) temporarily relax audit log retention for KMS to 30d -> but only for this region to avoid cost shock.
leah: careful on retention change, ops finance flagged any retention increase needs approval. alternative: stream logs to short-term S3 then down-sample. cheaper.
alex: agree. plan: cache + warm-pool downscale + fallback key + short-term S3 buffer for KMS logs. I'll own implementation of cache and pool change.
maria: I'll handle fallback key IAM policy and open cloud support. Sam, can you wire the S3 buffer for KMS logs and set lifecycle 14d?
sam: on it. Will add a temporary lambda to copy cloud-kms logs to s3/kms-buffer/ap-southeast1/ and apply lifecycle 14d.
leah: also add a Grafana alert for KMS DecryptOps per-minute > 1k for region, and a playbook runbook entry referencing this thread.
alex: quick patch incoming to canary:```--- a/deploy/node-agent-config.yaml
+++ b/deploy/node-agent-config.yaml
@@
 node_agent:
-  kms_cache: {}
+  kms_cache:
+    enabled: true
+    ttl_seconds: 900
+    ttl_jitter: 60
```
alex: pushing to canary now, will watch.
deploy-bot: deploy canary node-agent-config to ap-southeast1 started.
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded on 3/3 canary nodes.
alex: canary metrics: repeated decrypts dropped from ~12/min to ~1/min per node. DecryptOps overall down 45% in region. warm-pool renews still queued but fewer failures.
maria: IAM policy drafted:```{
  "Version": "2022-10-01",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect": "Allow","Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],"Resource": ["arn:cloud:kms:ap-southeast1:acct:keys/fallback-key"],"Condition": {"StringEquals": {"kms:Purpose": "bootstrap"}}}
  ]
}```
maria: applying delegation now with least privilege. will rotate fallback-key after incident.
sam: S3 buffer + lifecycle created. will monitor size and costs.
leah: finance: projected extra log cost ~ $120 for 2 weeks with lifecycle 14d, approved for incident window.
alex: good. autoscaler health improving, node boot success rate up to 98% now.
leah: postmortem items: - evaluate long-term approach (regional envelope keys vs per-node) - add automated warm-pool throttle when KMS QPS > threshold - update compliance checklist for fallback-key use - cost/runbook for short-term log buffering
maria: I'll file follow-ups and tag security/compliance for sign-off.
alex: thanks all. marking INCIDENT-APAC-KMS-THROTTLE as mitigated for now, keep monitoring for 24h.
audit-bot: Audit note: fallback-key usage recorded and archived to s3/kms-audit/ap-southeast1/ for 30 days.
leah: thanks — set a reminder for postmortem in 48h.
alex: thread summary: implemented node-agent cache, scaled down warm pool, enabled fallback-key for non-PII bootstraps, set up log buffer; support ticket pending. action owners: alex(cache+pool), maria(IAM+ticket), sam(log buffer), leah(runbook+alerts).
